facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹77,956 cr, +144% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹493 cr, +162% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹24,138 cr (+78% YoY), PAT ₹125 cr (+92% YoY), operating margin 3.1%.
Revenue has compounded at 94% over 5 and 97% over 3; the last twelve months (+144%) are running ahead of the 3-year pace.
Profit has compounded slower than revenue over 3 years (31% vs 97%): growth is costing margin.
Quarterly revenue growth has decelerated over the last four quarters: +202% → +196% → +182% → +78% YoY.
Operating margin is steady at 3.1% (1.8% a year ago).
Annual operating margin has ranged from −44% to 3% over five years; the latest year (2%) sits inside that range.
Borrowings are ₹5,757 cr against equity of ₹31,275 cr: debt/equity 0.18× (was 0.03× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 6.6× over the last twelve months.
The cash conversion cycle has lengthened to 2 days from −132 in Mar 2023 (payable days 178 → 36, debtor days 24 → 12): more cash is tied up in operations.
Foreign institutions hold 33.0%, −6.0 pp over a year.
Over 3 years, ₹1,586 cr of operating cash came from ₹1,888 cr of operating profit: 84% conversion; against PAT of ₹1,244 cr that is 1.3×.
Free cash flow was negative in 4 of the last 5 years; cumulative −₹2,988 cr, latest year −₹1,114 cr.
Capex ran at 3% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹1,746 cr (averaged 3% over the three years before).
Other income is 143% of pre-tax profit over the last twelve months — earnings lean on non-operating items.

business.what: Eternal Ltd operates in the digital commerce and services sector. It generates revenue through various business offerings, including the operation of dark stores and warehouses, advertising, marketing, and branding initiatives, and the development of technology infrastructure and capabilities.

claims.claim: Competitive intensity in food delivery was higher last quarter compared to previous quarters, partly driven by Zomato's own aggressive investments.
claims.quote: Generally, the competitive intensity last quarter in food delivery was higher compared to the previous few quarters, and partly also driven by Zomato.

claims.claim: The company is seeing robust economics and good paybacks in tier 2 markets, which are less competitive.
claims.quote: What we have seen so far is that the economics are pretty robust. Paybacks are extremely good in these markets. The other point is also true that these markets are less competitive

claims.claim: The company is at a steady state where 90-95% of quick commerce SKUs are 1P, with no further incremental working capital change expected.
claims.quote: Jignanshu, we are at that steady state now where about 90-95% is 1P, and we don't expect any more incremental working capital change on that account

claims.claim: Quick commerce competition is more predictable now compared to the last 12 months, allowing for more aggressive infrastructure expansion.
claims.quote: But now, as we mentioned last time also, competition is more predictable now, and that provides an opportunity for us to become more aggressive on infrastructure expansion.

claims.claim: Competitive intensity in quick commerce reached its peak in the first quarter of FY27.
claims.quote: First quarter, so far, was the peak of competitive intensity that we have seen till date because the number of players is higher and everybody was more aggressive.

claims.claim: Competitive intensity in quick commerce has become more predictable.
claims.quote: Most competitors are going towards grocery subsidizing, which we are fairly clear about in terms of what we do in that and what is the kind of impact that it has on the business.

claims.claim: Discount-led growth is not sustainable in the quick commerce business.
claims.quote: we strongly feel that discount-led growth is not sustainable in the business.

claims.claim: The company expects to continue adding about 10 kitchens per quarter for the Bistro business.
claims.quote: Broadly, we are adding about 10-odd kitchens in a quarter, that's the pace of expansion there.

claims.claim: We feel a lot of our competitors in the market have pulled back on this so we're seeing extremely low cost of customer acquisition
claims.quote: We feel a lot of our competitors in the market have pulled back on this so we're seeing extremely low cost of customer acquisition

claims.claim: The statement that we have made includes all the businesses that we are in today, including Hyperpure.
claims.quote: The statement that we have made includes all the businesses that we are in today, including Hyperpure.

claims.claim: The full benefit of shifting to an inventory model should accrue in the next six to nine months, and the benefit will not be more than 1%.
claims.quote: the full benefit should accrue in the next six to nine months, and the benefit will not be more than 1%.

claims.claim: In most of the Tier 1 markets, which is the metros, we have largely maintained our share of NOV.
claims.quote: in most of the Tier 1 markets, which is the metros, we have largely maintained our share of NOV

claims.claim: The new labor codes do not impact our long-term margin guidance.
claims.quote: the new labor codes do not impact our long-term margin guidance.

claims.claim: We don't expect net working capital to be beyond those 18 days that we had shared earlier.
claims.quote: we don't expect net working capital to be beyond those 18 days that we had shared earlier

claims.claim: The company expects the 1% margin accretion from the inventory model transition to take four to six quarters to fully realize.
claims.quote: the overall margin accretion of 1% will take some while, because it requires you to negotiate with brands... that process cannot happen in one shot.

claims.claim: The company is seeing soft discretionary demand in India in the last few months.
claims.quote: the headwinds have been strong, including the soft discretionary demand in India in the last few months.

claims.claim: The company expects absolute losses in the District business to remain range-bound around current levels.
claims.quote: we expect the absolute losses to sort of remain range bound around the current levels.

claims.claim: Marketing spend for Blinkit is expected to remain elevated in the near term.
claims.quote: Yes, at least likely in the near term, and that's what Albinder mentioned in response to a previous question that we do expect these levels to continue at least for now.

claims.claim: Less than 5% of overall growth in the quarter came from expansion areas not served earlier.
claims.quote: Even in this quarter when we opened a lot more cities, less than 5% of the overall growth came from the expansion areas that we were not serving earlier.

claims.claim: Quick commerce adjusted EBITDA margins improved from -2.4% to -1.8% in this quarter.
claims.quote: directionally, as you can see, the margins have improved from -2.4% to -1.8% in this quarter.

claims.claim: Year-on-year food delivery growth has bottomed out based on the first three weeks of the quarter.
claims.quote: basis what we have seen so far in the first three weeks of the quarter, the year-on-year growth has sort of bottomed out
